$comment: The closed vocabulary of the industrial design domain: the object categories of an interior, the object types with their parts and the forms, materials, finishes and textures each one can take, and the materials, finishes and textures themselves. Styles and object nets refer to these ids; the validator checks each reference.

categories.name: Sanitary ware
categories.scope: Taps, basins, WCs, showers, baths and their fittings: the wet objects of a bathroom.

categories.name: Electrics
categories.scope: Switches, sockets, dimmers and visible cables: the small hardware on each wall.

categories.name: Lighting and window hardware
categories.scope: Light fittings, and the rods and tracks that carry curtains.

categories.name: Storage
categories.scope: Cabinets, shelving, wardrobes and the handles and hooks on them.

categories.name: Tables and chairs
categories.scope: Dining, low, side and work tables, and the hard chairs at them.

categories.name: Kitchen amenities
categories.scope: Kitchen fronts, worktops, sinks, hoods and the objects on the counter and the table.

categories.name: Decor
categories.scope: Frames, vases, plant pots, mirrors, rugs and small objects.

textures.name: Mirror-smooth
textures.description: A surface with no felt structure; it shows a sharp reflection.

textures.name: Satin-smooth
textures.description: A smooth surface with a soft, diffused reflection.

textures.name: Fine close grain
textures.description: A close wood grain such as beech, maple or birch, with pores under 0.1 mm.

textures.name: Open grain
textures.description: An open, ring-porous grain such as oak or ash, with visible pores.

textures.name: Figured grain
textures.description: A veneer figure: burl, crotch, stripe or flame.

textures.name: Brush lines
textures.description: Parallel fine lines from an abrasive belt, about 0.05 mm deep.

textures.name: Hammered
textures.description: Overlapping facets of hand or machine hammer blows, 5 to 15 mm wide.

textures.name: Knurled
textures.description: A cross-hatched or straight grip pattern cut into a round part.

textures.name: Fluted or reeded
textures.description: Parallel concave or convex ribs, 4 to 20 mm apart.

textures.name: Ribbed
textures.description: Raised parallel ribs, 2 to 6 mm apart.

textures.name: Crackle glaze
textures.description: A fine net of cracks in the glaze.

textures.name: Speckled clay
textures.description: Dark iron specks that show through a pale glaze.

textures.name: Throwing rings
textures.description: The spiral ridges of a wheel-thrown pot.

textures.name: Veined
textures.description: Natural or cast veins across a smooth stone face.

textures.name: Porous or pitted
textures.description: Open pores and pits, as in travertine or pumice.

textures.name: Board-marked
textures.description: The print of timber formwork in concrete.

textures.name: Trowelled
textures.description: Soft cloudy swirls of a hand trowel.

textures.name: Exposed aggregate
textures.description: Chips of stone or glass that show in a ground matrix.

textures.name: Plain weave
textures.description: An even over-under weave with no visible pattern.

textures.name: Slub weave
textures.description: An uneven yarn with thick and thin parts, as in linen.

textures.name: Twill or herringbone
textures.description: Diagonal ribs from an offset weave.

textures.name: Bouclé loops
textures.description: A surface of small closed yarn loops.

textures.name: Cut pile
textures.description: Short upright fibres, as in velvet or mohair.

textures.name: Knotted pile
textures.description: Hand-knotted or tufted pile of a rug, 6 to 25 mm deep.

textures.name: Button-tufted
textures.description: Deep buttoned pleats in a diamond grid.

textures.name: Channel-quilted
textures.description: Parallel padded channels, 6 to 15 cm wide.

textures.name: Woven cane
textures.description: An open octagonal cane web.

textures.name: Plaited or wicker weave
textures.description: A dense plait of fibre strands.

textures.name: Pressed pattern
textures.description: A low-relief pattern pressed or embossed into the sheet.

textures.name: Cast relief ornament
textures.description: A raised cast motif: a leaf, a scroll, a bead.

textures.name: Etched or frosted
textures.description: A fine matte scatter on glass that softens the light.

textures.name: Seeded
textures.description: Small trapped air bubbles in mouth-blown glass.

textures.name: Grain leather
textures.description: The natural pore pattern of full-grain hide.

textures.name: Orange-peel
textures.description: The fine dimple of a powder coat or a sprayed lacquer.

textures.name: Tool marks
textures.description: Visible marks of a chisel, a plane or a file.
